items.title: Franklin Templeton makes room for HYPE in crypto index ETF

items.title: World Liberty-Linked Wallet Swaps WETH and mETH for $20M in Stablecoins
items.summary: The wallet showed zero balances of native ETH, WETH and mETH after the trades.

items.title: Could AI Break Bitcoin? Not Yet, Research Firm K33 Says
items.summary: A draft AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis renewed worries about the math securing Bitcoin, but K33 says no cryptographic compromise has been demonstrated.

items.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin price recovery needs USDT supply growth
items.summary: Bitcoin needs USDT supply to start growing again for a sustained price recovery, according to CryptoQuant.
